title_ko: A Historic Overview of Literacy Studies: From Orality to AI-Mediated Literacies
title_en: A Historic Overview of Literacy Studies: From Orality to AI-Mediated Literacies
kw_ko: 문해 연구; 신문해학 (New Literacy Studies); 학문적 문해력; 사회문화이론; AI 문해력
kw_en: Literacy Studies; Sociocultural Theory; Academic Literacy; New Literacy Studies; AI Literacy
abstract_ko: This paper provides a historical and synthetic overview of literacy studies, tracing major theoretical paradigms from early concerns about orality and writing to behaviorist and cognitive perspectives, sociocultural and critical shifts, and the emergence of New Literacy Studies. The discussion integrates key theoretical frameworks, including Vygotsky’s sociocultural perspective, Bakhtin’s dialogism, Bourdieu’s cultural capital, and Street’s ideological model of literacy, all of which have reoriented the field from skill-based models to those emphasizing practice and power. The paper further explores how literacy has expanded into digital, multimodal, and global contexts, with a particular focus on academic literacy and English for Academic Purposes (EAP), where genre-based and discourse-community perspectives have reshaped pedagogical approaches. The paper makes a critical contribution by arguing that literacy studies is at a pivotal inflection point: the rise of AI-mediated systems, algorithmic sorting, and the rhetorical demands of prompt design necessitate an expansion of the field’s conceptual toolkit. Specifically, the study calls for the integration of AI literacy, prompt literacy, and algorithmic/data literacies into educational frameworks, which challenge traditional notions of authorship, agency, and pedagogy. This paper uniquely contributes by offering empirical and pedagogical insights for elementary, secondary, and tertiary education, detailing how AI-related literacies should be integrated into curricula to foster critical engagement, ethical reasoning, and equitable access. In doing so, it presents actionable recommendations for developing literacy programs that maintain humanistic values and ensure educational equity in rapidly evolving digital and AI-infused learning environments.

title_ko: 영어과 AI 디지털 교과서 교수·학습 모형 제안 연구
title_en: Proposing teaching models for AI digital textbooks in English education
kw_ko: 영어 AI 디지털교과서; 맞춤형 학습; 개인화 학습; 학습 분석; 교수모형
kw_en: English AI Digital Textook; Customized Learning; Personalized Learning; Learning Analytics; Teaching Model
abstract_ko: To prepare for digital transformation and the era of AI, Korea’s Ministry of Education announced the implementation of AI digital textbooks in English, mathematics, and computer science in elementary and secondary schools starting in 2025. AIDT aims at personalized/customized learning through AI-based learning analytics. AIDT can be an effective alternative tool to provide personalized/ customized learning in addition to traditional English classrooms. However, in the first year of implementation, models for effectively integrating AIDT into the classroom are still rare. Since instructional approaches and models are crucial for successful implementation and student learning, the purpose of this study is to present effective instructional models using AIDT. As a research method, the study analyzed the characteristics and specifics of AIDT and then applied them to the teaching models based on the characteristics of AIDT and the communicative language teaching approach. This study presents three models, task-based, project-based and problem-based language teaching, which English teachers can use in their teaching with AIDT. The models can be used as guidelines for teachers to integrate AIDT into their classrooms.

abstract_ko: ChatGPT의 출현으로 인해 가장 큰 충격을 받은 분야 중의 하나가 교육이며 이 중에서도 가장 혼란스러운 분야는 글쓰기 교육일 것이다. 글쓰기는 교육의 모든 분야에서 가장 기본적인 학습 도구이자 학습자의 지식과 학습 능력을 측정하는 대상이라는 점에서 ChatGPT의 출현은 교육의 패러다임에 근본적인 변화를 요구하는 시발점으로 작용할 수 있다. 문식 환경이 디지털 기반으로 급격하게 변화되는 상황과 이를 빠르게 수용하는 학습자들에 대해 교육이 효과적으로 대응하지 못함으로써 발생하는 과제들도 적지 않다. 하지만 기술 발전으로 인한 문식 환경의 빠른 변화에 능동적으로 대응하지 않으면 교육 본연의 역할을 원활하게 수행하지 못할 가능성이 커진다는 점은 분명하다. 글쓰기 교육에 종사하는 교수자들 중 일부는 글쓰기의 기초를 습득하는데 투여되어야 하는 노력과 시간을 ChatGPT가 해결해주는 것을 수많은 나눗셈에서 자신의 해방시키는 계산기의 발명에 비유한다. 그들은 ChatGPT 때문에 과제를 직접 필기하거나 수업시간에 제출하는 것으로 대응하려는 일부 교수자들에게 대부분의 학생들이 오랫 시간 동안 노력을 해도 일정 수준 이상에 도달하지 못하는 글쓰기의 기초 능력을 갖추게 하려는 교육 방식을 더 이상 수행할 가치가 있는가라고 반문한다. 그동안 열심히 학습하고 관련된 지식과 경험을 갖추고 있음에도 글쓰기 능력이 부족하다는 이유로 평가에서 높은 등급을 받지 못하는 것을 부당하다고 생각하는 뉴질랜드의 한 학생은 ChatGPT 활용을 옹호한다. 그의 입장은 글쓰기 능력이 곧 학습자의 사고력이나 문제해결능력을 나타내는 척도가 될 수 없다는 논리와 연결되며 나아가 글쓰기의 기초 능력을 갖추는데 너무 많은 시간과 노력을 소비하는 것은 생산적이지 못하다는 견해로 확대될 수 있다. 생성 인공지능의 일상적 활용이 가능해지면서 어떻게 질문해야 하는가, 즉 질문하는 기술이 문제해결능력의 척도이자 통찰과 창의성의 새로운 영역으로 자리매김할 가능성이 적지 않다. 생성 인공지능의 출현을 가장 비관적으로 인식하는 사람들의 공통점은 인공지능이 인간의 역할을 완전히 대체한다고 본다는 점이다. 하지만 생성 인공지능이 인간을 대체할 수 없으며 인간과 협력하는 존재로 자리매김할 가능성이 높다. 인간이 창의적인 프롬프트를 생성 인공지능에 제공하고 인공지능은 이를 효과적으로 처리하여 가능한 옵션들을 제공한다. 인간은 다시 옵션을 선택하고 이를 편집하여 원하는 부분을 추가하여 마무리하는 샌드위치 워크플로는 창의적 능력은 인간에게만 존재하는 능력임을 증명한다. 생성 인공지능은 수정할 수 있는 출발점을 제공하는 기능을 수행할 뿐이다. 따라서 어떤 부분을 수정할 것인가, 그리고 어떤 방향으로 수정을 해나갈 것인가가 생성물을 최적화할 수 있는 키워드로서 이러한 키워드 생성은 인간만이 수행할 수 있는 능력이다.
abstract_en: One of the areas that has been most shocked by the emergence of ChatGPT is education, and perhaps the most disruptive of these areas is the teaching of writing. Since writing is the most basic learning tool in all areas of education, and an object to measure learners' knowledge and ability to learn, the emergence of ChatGPT can act as a starting point that requires a fundamental change in the paradigm of education. There are not a few challenges that arise if education does not respond effectively to the rapidly changing literacy environment and the learners who are rapidly adopting it. However, it is clear that if we do not actively respond to the rapid changes in the literacy environment due to technological development, there is a high probability that education will not be able to smoothly fulfil its original role. Some of the teachers involved in the teaching of writing liken the solution offered by ChatGPT to the effort and time that must be invested in mastering the basics of writing to the invention of the calculator, which frees them from numerous divisions. They say that ChatGPT makes it impossible for some teachers to respond to handwriting or handing in assignments in class, a style of teaching that aims to provide students with basic writing skills that most students do not achieve beyond a certain level of effort over a long period of time. Ask yourself if it's worth it. A student in New Zealand who feels it is unfair that he is not getting a good grade in his assessment because of his lack of writing skills, even though he has studied hard and has relevant knowledge and experience, advocates the use of ChatGPT. His position advocating the use of ChatGPT is linked to the logic that writing skills cannot be a measure of a learner's thinking or problem-solving ability, and furthermore that spending too much time and effort on acquiring basic writing skills is not productive. As generative artificial intelligence becomes available for everyday use, there is a strong possibility that the way questions are asked, the ability to ask questions, will become a measure of problem-solving ability and a new area of insight and creativity. The common denominator of those who are most pessimistic about the emergence of generative AI is that they see AI as completely replacing the role of humans. However, generative AI cannot replace humans, and it is highly likely that it will establish itself as a collaborator with humans. Humans provide creative prompts to generative AI, which effectively processes them and presents possible options. The sandwich workflow, in which humans re-select options, edit them and add desired parts to complete them, proves that creative ability is a human-only skill. Generative AI only serves to provide a starting point that can be modified. Therefore, which part to modify and in which direction to make the modification are keywords that can optimise the product, and such keyword generation is a skill that only humans can perform.

title_ko: 멀티모달 AI를 활용한 《당시삼백수》 학습과 교학
title_en: Multimodal AI-Assisted Learning and Teaching Approaches to the Three Hundred Tang Poems
kw_ko: 인공지능; 멀티모달; 챗GPT-5; 중국시 학습; 중국시 교학; 당시삼백수
kw_en: Atificial Intelligence; Multimodal; Chat GPT-5; Chinese Poetry learning; Chinese Poetry Teaching; Three Hundred Tang Poems
abstract_ko: The emergence of the Fourth Industrial Revolution has accelerated the integration of cutting-edge IT technologies into diverse fields, thereby shaping a more interconnected and intelligent society. Among these innovations, Artificial Intelligence(AI) has rapidly advanced into mainstream application, evoking comparisons with the flourishing schools of thought during the Warring States period. Within this context, the potential role of AI in the humanities-particularly in literary research and pedagogy—has garnered increasing attention. This paper continues the author’s line of inquiry into how AI can contribute to the study and instruction of classical Chinese poetry. It takes Three Hundred Tang Poems, one of the most widely circulated and representative anthologies of Tang poetry, as its central text. While traditional scholarship has primarily emphasized philological and textual approaches, this study explores new methodologies by leveraging the multimodal affordances of AI. The research is divided into two sections. The first focuses on learning applications, in which ChatGPT-5 is employed to analyze the anthology and generate visualizations such as statistical charts and word clouds. The second addresses teaching applications, examining how AI can be integrated into instructional contexts-for example, by offering poetic feedback and employing images or videos to enhance student engagement. In doing so, this study aims to demonstrate the potential of AI not only as an analytical tool but also as a pedagogical partner in the field of Chinese classical poetry.“

title_ko: 한국어 교육에서의 AI 활용에 대한 한국어 교사들의 인식 연구
title_en: A Study on Korean Language Teachers' Perceptions of AI Utilization in Korean Language Education
kw_ko: AI 교육; AI 교사 인식; AI 활용능력; 심층 면담
kw_en: AI education; Awareness of AI Teachers; Ability to utilize AI; an in-depth interview
abstract_ko: This study aims to investigate Korean language teachers' interest in, understanding of, and experience with AI, as well as their expectations and concerns regarding AI technologies. The research aims to understand the diverse perspectives teachers hold about AI and, based on these insights, to propose more practical and effective ways of integrating AI into Korean language education. To this end, a quantitative survey was conducted among instructors in the field of Korean language education, and qualitative research was carried out through in-depth interviews with instructors who have experience using AI in their teaching. A triangulation approach was applied to develop quantitative survey items and semi-structured interview questions focused on the role and application of AI in the educational setting. The collected data were analyzed for reliability and validity, and the expert interview findings were organized to complement the survey results. The findings revealed that text-generating AI and translation AI can enhance the potential for personalized instruction by allowing teachers to provide prompt feedback on learners' writing and pronunciation. Many Korean language teachers recognized AI as a useful supplementary tool in education and evaluated it positively, particularly in terms of saving time and improving efficiency in lesson preparation and learner feedback. The study thus highlights the significance of enhancing teachers’AI literacy and promoting further research and practice of AI-based educational models in language learning for educational innovation.

title_ko: 영어과 AI 융합수업에 관한 초등교사의 경험 및 인식
title_en: Exploring elementary school teachers’ experiences and perceptions of English–AI convergence classes
kw_ko: 영어 AI융합수업; 초등영어 교사; 영어교사교육; 제2언어교사교육
kw_en: English–AI convergence classes; elementary English teachers; English teacher education; second language teacher education
abstract_ko: This study explored how elementary English teachers conceptualized and implemented English–AI convergence classes. Four elementary school teachers participated, and data were collected through semi-structured interviews and reflective journals. The data were analyzed qualitatively using content analysis. Findings revealed that teachers held varying perceptions of English–AI convergence instruction: some viewed it as an aspect of interdisciplinary teaching, while others regarded it as a form of curriculum-level restructuring. Motivations for implementation included intrinsic interest and awareness of AI’s instructional potential. Teachers expressed significant concern about the lack of applicable instructional models, as well as ethical and technical challenges. In practice, they utilized diverse AI tools to tailor lessons to classroom contexts. Reported outcomes included enhanced personalized learning and increased student engagement. However, challenges such as students’ overreliance on AI, limited teacher preparedness, and inadequate infrastructure were also noted. Teachers emphasized the need for high-quality, context-sensitive professional development and proposed improvements in teacher education, school environments, educational platforms, and policy support. As AI technologies continue to advance in education, addressing teachers’ perceptions and building their competencies is essential for meaningful integration. This study offers practical insights and suggests directions for the sustainable implementation of English–AI convergence instruction in elementary education.

title_ko: 인터랙티브 중국어 관용어 학습 AI 플랫폼 LexiChinese의 설계와 활용
title_en: LexiChinese: Designing an Interactive AI Platform for Chinese Idiom Teaching and Learning
kw_ko: 중국어 교육; 에듀테크; 대형언어모델(LLM); 성어(成语); 헐후어(歇后语); 한국어 대응 표현; 예문·퀴즈 생성
kw_en: LexiChinese; Chinese Education; Edutech; Large Language Model (LLM); Chengyu; Xiehouyu; Korean Counterpart Expressions; Example and Quiz Generation
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 대형언어모델(LLM)을 기반으로 한 인터랙티브 중국어 관용 표현 학습 플랫폼LexiChinese의 설계·구현 및 교육적 활용 방안을 제시한다. 중국어의 성어, 헐후어, 속담·격언, 개념적 은유와 같은 관용 표현은 그 비구성적 특성과 역사문화적 배경으로 인해 교수자와 학습자 모두에게 까다로운 영역이다. 이러한 표현을 LLM이 어떻게 처리하는지를 체계적으로 파악하기 위해 의미·용법 설명(T1), 한국어 대응 표현 제시(T2), 용례 적합성 판단(T3)이라는 세 가지 하위 과제를 고안하여 GPT, Claude, DeepSeek 세 모델에 시험 적용하였다. 분석 결과 확인된 GPT와 Claude의 강점은 LexiChinese 플랫폼의 주요 기능인 관용어 의미 탐색기, 예문 생성기, 퀴즈 생성기에 직접 반영하였으며, 허구적 고사 창작 및 의미 해석 오류가 나타났던 DeepSeek의 오답 사례는 학생이 틀리기 쉬운 ‘함정 분석’ 교육자료로 역활용되었다. 특히 본 플랫폼은 학습자의 자율 학습을 돕는 ‘학습자 모드’와 교사의 수업 설계를 지원하는 ‘교사 모드’의 이중 모드 인터페이스를 제공하여 교육 현장의 다양한 요구를 동시에 충족한다. 본 연구는 LLM을 특정 언어 교육 목적에 맞게 도구화하는 구체적인 사례를 제시하고 이를 실제 교육용 플랫폼으로 구현하였다는 점에서 선행 연구들과 차별화되는 학술적·실용적 의의를 지닌다. LexiChinese는 오픈소스로 공개되어 있으며 온라인 데모를 통해 실제 교육 현장에서 활용할 수 있다.
abstract_en: This study presents the design, implementation, and pedagogical application of LexiChinese, an interactive Chinese idiom learning platform powered by Large Language Models (LLMs). Idiomatic expressions such as Chengyu, Xiehouyu (two-part allegorical sayings), proverbs/maxims, and conceptual metaphors pose considerable challenges for both teachers and learners due to their non-compositional semantics and deep socio-historical roots. To systematically investigate how LLMs handle these expressions, three sub-tasks were devised: meaning and usage explanation (T1), Korean counterpart identification (T2), and contextual appropriateness judgment (T3), each tested across GPT, Claude, and DeepSeek. The strengths identified in GPT and Claude were directly integrated into the platform's core features, such as the Idiom Explorer, Example Generator, and Quiz Generator. In contrast, DeepSeek's recurring errors including historical hallucinations and semantic misinterpretations, were repurposed as educational materials for analyzing common learner pitfalls. Notably, the platform offers a dual-mode interface: a Learner Mode for self-study and a Teacher Mode for lesson planning, enabling a single platform to serve diverse classroom needs. This study distinguishes itself from prior work both in its methodological and practical contributions, offering a concrete case of adapting LLMs to a specialized language education and realizing it as a fully functional edutech platform. LexiChinese is available as an open-source project with an online demo for use in real-world classroom settings.

title_ko: 생성형 AI 기반 피드백을 통한 학문 목적 중국인 한국어 학습자의 정체성 전환에 대한 내러티브 탐구 — ChatGPT 활용 사례를 중심으로
title_en: A Narrative Inquiry into the Identity Transformation of Chinese Learners of Korean for Academic Purposes through Generative AI -Based Feedback — Focusing on ChatGPT Interaction
kw_ko: 생성적 인공지능; 학문적 한국어 학습; 내러티브 탐구; 정체성 재구성
kw_en: ChatGPT; Generative AI; Academic Korean Language Learning; Narrative Inquiry; Identity Reconstruction
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 생성형 인공지능(GAI) 기반 피드백의 수용과 내면화 과정이 학문 목적 중국인 고급 한국어 학습자의 정체성 전환에 어떠한 질적 변화를 초래하는지를 내러티브 탐구 방법론을 통해 분석하였다. 이를 위해 한국 대학원에 재학 중인 두 명의 중국인 학습자를 대상으로 총 세 차례에 걸쳐 온·오프라인 반구조화 면담을 실시하고, ChatGPT 기반 피드백 상호작용 경험을 시간적, 맥락적 흐름 속에서 심층적으로 분석하였다. 분석 결과, 학습자들은 GAI 피드백을 단순한 오류 수정 도구로 수용하는 것을 넘어 자신의 언어산출을 전략적으로 점검하고 조정하는 자기조절적 실천을 내면화하였다. 이러한 자기조절 능력은 담화 구조 설계, 사고 흐름 정돈, 청중 인식을 고려한 표현 전략 형성으로 확장되었으며, 학문 담화 공동체 내에서 정당한 수행 주체로 자리매김하려는 정체성 전환 양상을 보여주었다. 본 연구는 생성형 인공지능 기반 피드백이 학습자의 언어 능력 향상을 넘어, 학문적 자기 표현과 존재론적 정체성 형성에 실질적으로 기여할 수 있음을 실증적으로 제시하였다. 이를 통해 GAI 기반 피드백이 학문 목적 외국어 학습자의 언어적 자기화과정과 주체성 구성에 있어 의미 있는 교육적 매개로 작용할 수 있음을 논의하였다.
abstract_en: This study investigates qualitative changes in the identity transformation of advanced Chinese learners of Korean, particularly for academic purposes, through the internalization of generative artificial intelligence (GAI)-based feedback. Utilizing a narrative inquiry methodology, three rounds of semi-structured online and offline interviews were conducted with two Chinese graduate students enrolled at a Korean university. Their experiences with ChatGPT-based feedback were analyzed within a temporal and contextual framework. The findings reveal that the learners internalized GAI feedback not merely as a tool for error correction but also as a means to strategically monitor and regulate their linguistic output through self-regulated practices. Their self-regulatory competence expanded to encompass discourse structuring, thought flow organization, and formation of audience-oriented expression strategies, illustrating their transition into legitimate academic performers within the academic discourse community. This study empirically demonstrates that GAIbased feedback contributes not only to linguistic proficiency but also to the development of academic self-expression and ontological identity formation. Furthermore, it discusses the potential of GAI feedback as a meaningful pedagogical mediator that supports the process of linguistic selfing and the construction of subjectivity among foreign language learners for academic purposes.

title_ko: 중국어 교육을 위한 프롬프트 기법 탐색 ― 계층적 프롬프트를 중심으로
title_en: Exploring Prompting Techniques for Chinese Language Education : Focusing on Hierarchical Prompting
kw_en: Chinese Language Education; Prompting Techniques; Large Language Models; AI in Education; Prompt Literacy; Hierarchical Prompting
abstract_ko: This study looked through effective prompting techniques for Chinese language education using Large Language Models. Since ChatGPT's emergence in 2022, LLMs have developed rapidly, with educational models enhancing its education capabilities. Effective application requires prompting strategies that consider Chinese language's unique characteristics. Through literature review and case analysis, this research examines the development of prompt engineering and explores prompt techniques suitable for Chinese language education. The findings indicate that reasoning techniques align with Chinese language's progressive learning structure. Structured frameworks provide systematic prompt design approaches. Hierarchical prompting suits graduated difficulty levels, and specialized techniques enhance instructional clarity. Specifically, least-to-most prompting is effective for pronunciation and vocabulary learning, role prompting for conversation practice, and chain-of-verification prompting for writing instruction.

title_en: A Case Study on English Test Item Development Training for Secondary School Teachers Using AI Tools: Focusing on ChatGPT
kw_en: generative AI; test item development; ChatGPT; ATG; AIG
abstract_ko: This study analyzed the use of various AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT) by ten teachers who participated in a secondary teacher training program hosted by University A in January 2023. The training program was conducted over three days, and after learning how to use AI tools, the teachers were asked to apply the AI tools in the actual practice of test item development, particularly for reading test items in the College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT). The study divided the test item development process into five stages: 1) passage creation; 2) test item creation; 3) test item selection; 4) vocabulary level control; and 5) refining details such as styling, choice length, and so on. At each stage, the cases showed that Al tools could significantly contribute to improving the efficiency of developing test items. The teachers also responded very positively to the training program, and the conclusion section discussed future challenges and further research.

title_ko: 『당시화보(唐詩畫譜)』및 AI 이미지 생성 기능을 활용한 당시(唐詩) 교육 방법 제안

kw_ko: 『당시화보(唐詩畫譜)』; 생성형 AI; 시의도(詩意圖); 당시(唐詩); 교육법; 멀티모달(multi-modal)
kw_en: 『唐詩畫譜』、生成式 AI、詩意圖、唐詩、教學法、多模態; Tangshi huapu(唐詩畫譜); Tangshi(唐詩); Tang poetry; education; generative AI; poetic image; multimodality; classical poetry education; pedagogical method
abstract_ko: 본고에서는 명대 후기 간행된 『당시화보(唐詩畫譜)』와 생성형 AI를 융합하여 당시(唐詩) 교육에 활용하는 새로운 방법을 모색하였다. 『당시화보』는 당시(唐詩) 작품을 문자로만 제시하는 것이 아니라 시적 정서와 장면을 회화적으로 형상화한 삽화를 함께 수록한 시·서·화 결합형 문헌이다. 이러한 특성은 텍스트와 이미지를 함께 처리하는 생성형 AI의 멀티모달 기능과 연결될 수 있으며, 고전시가 교육에서 학습자의 이해와 감상을 확장하는 데 유용한 자료로서 활용 가능하다. 본고는 실제 『당시화보』에 수록된 작품 몇 수를 활용하여 원본 삽화와 AI 생성 이미지를 비교하는 수업 방안을 제안하였다. 학습자는 작품의 원문을 해석하고 시어, 공간, 인물, 계절감, 색채, 정서 등을 분석한 뒤, 이를 바탕으로 생성형 AI를 활용하여 새로운 시의도(詩意圖)를 제작할 수 있다. 이 과정을 통해 학습자는 단순 번역과 암기 중심의 당시 교육에서 벗어나 언어와 이미지, 전통적 감상과 현대 기술을 연결하는 융합적 학습이 가능하다. 다만 생성형 AI는 환각, 출처 오류, 문헌 해석 단순화 등의 한계성을 가지므로, 그 결과물은 반드시 원문, 주석, 기존 연구 등과 반드시 대조하여 비판적으로 검토하는 과정을 거쳐야 한다. 따라서 본고는 AI를 교수자나 학습자를 대체하는 주체가 아니라 고전시가 교육을 보조하는 협업적 도구로 설정하였다. 결국 『당시화보』와 생성형 AI의 융합적 활용은 AI 시대 고전문학 교육의 실천적 방향을 제시하는 하나의 방법론이 될 수 있을 것이다.
abstract_en: This paper explores a new method for teaching Tang poetry by integrating the late-Ming illustrated anthology Tangshi huapu(唐詩畫譜) with generative artificial intelligence. As generative AI has rapidly developed from a text-based chatbot into a multimodal tool capable of processing language, images, documents, and other media, it has become necessary to reconsider its role in classical literature education. However, AI still produces hallucinations, inaccurate references, and oversimplified interpretations of classical texts. Therefore, this study regards AI not as a substitute for teachers or learners, but as a collaborative tool that can support interpretation, comparison, and classroom design. Tangshi huapu(唐詩畫譜) is especially suitable for this purpose because it combines Tang poems, calligraphy, and illustrations. Its images visualize poetic scenes, emotions, spatial settings, and implied meanings, allowing learners to approach poems through both verbal and visual channels. This paper examines several examples, and proposes classroom activities in which students compare the original illustrations with AI-generated poetic images. Through prompt design and image comparison, learners can actively analyze setting, character, seasonality, color, sound, atmosphere, and poetic emotion. Such activities move Tang poetry education beyond translation and memorization toward an integrated model connecting language, image, tradition, and technology. At the same time, AI-generated results must be critically verified through original texts, commentaries, and previous scholarship. Ultimately, this approach suggests a practical direction for classical poetry education in the age of artificial intelligence.

title_ko: 문법 자질을 활용한 한국어 학습자의 쓰기 숙달도 자동 평가 연구
title_en: Automatic Assessment of Korean Learner’s Writing Proficiency Based on Grammatical Features
kw_ko: 한국어교육; 쓰기; 자동평가; 문법 자질; 머신 러닝
kw_en: Korean Language Education; Writing; Automated Assessment; Grammatical Feature; Machine Learning
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 한국어 학습자의 쓰기 숙달도를 자동으로 평가하기 위해 문법 및 표층 자질을 분석하고 그 타당성을 검증하였다. 이를 위하여 국립국어원의 ‘한국어 학습자 말뭉치’를 연구 대상으로 삼아 초급, 중급, 고급 수준의 쓰기 데이터 총 14,992편을 활용하였다. 자질은 통사적 복잡도, 문법 난이도, 글의 길이, 형태소 사용 분포의 네 가지 자질군으로 구분하여 추출하였다. 피어슨 상관관계 분석과 머신러닝 모델(Random Forest, XGBoost)을 통해 자질의 중요도를 평가한 결과, 문장당 관형형전성어미 수, 3급 문법 토큰 수, 문장 길이 지표, 종결어미 비율 등이 쓰기 숙달도 평가의 주요 지표로 나타났다. 특히 형태소 사용 분포 관련 자질을 추가한 경우 모든 숙달도 수준에서 모델의 분류 성능이 크게 향상되는 것으로 확인되었다. 본 연구의 결과는 한국어 쓰기 숙달도 평가에서 문법 사용 양상의 중요성을 실증적으로 검증하였다는 점에서 의의가 있다. 향후 연구에서는 문법 오류 분석을 함께 고려하거나 중급 학습자의 언어적 특성을 보다 잘 반영할 수 있는 자질 개발이 필요할 것으로 보인다.
abstract_en: This study investigates the automatic assessment of Korean learners’ writing proficiency by extracting and validating grammatical and surface-level features. Using 14,992 essays from the Korean Learners’ Corpus, 101 features were extracted across four categories: syntactic complexity, grammar difficulty, text length, and morpheme usage. Pearson correlation analysis and machine learning models (Random Forest and XGBoost) were employed to identify the most predictive features. Findings indicated that noun modifier endings per sentence, frequency of Level 3 grammar tokens, average sentence length, and ratios of sentence-final ending emerged as critical indicators of writing proficiency. In addition, integrating morpheme-related features significantly improved classification accuracy across all proficiency levels. The results highlight the importance of grammatical usage patterns in assessing Korean writing proficiency. Future research should include grammatical error analysis and develop additional features that better capture the linguistic characteristics of intermediate-level learners.

title_ko: 글쓰기 맥락에서 대학생 필자의 생성형 AI 수용 인식 연구 - 인공지능 기기 수용(AIDUA) 모형에 기반한 수용 구조 탐색과 타당도 검증 -
title_en: University Students’ Perceptions of Generative AI Acceptance in Writing Contexts -An Exploration of Acceptance Structure and Validity Based on the AIDUA (Artificial Intelligence Device Use Acceptance)
kw_ko: 국어교육; 작문 교육; 생성형 AI 글쓰기; AIDUA 모형; 학습자 인식
kw_en: Korean Language Education; Writing Education; Generative AI Writing; AIDUA Model; Students’ Perception
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 글쓰기 맥락에서 생성형 AI에 대한 대학생 필자의 수용 인식을 탐색하고, 이를 설명할 수 있는 이론적 모형을 도출 및 검증하는 것을 목적으로 하였다. 이를 위해 인공지능 기기 수용 모형(AIDUA)을 토대로 ‘인지–수용–도입’의 3단계 구조를 설정하고, 각 단계에 해당하는 인식 요인을 도출하여 전체 수용 인식 구조를 구성하였다. 생성형 AI를 활용한 글쓰기 경험이 있는 대학생 75명을 대상으로 설문조사를 실시하고, 탐색적 요인 분석을 통해 수용 인식 구조를 도출하였다. 분석 결과, 학습자의 수용 인식은 ‘탐색적 동기’, ‘인지된 인간성’, ‘사회적 영향력’, ‘실용성 기대’, ‘평가적 태도’의 다섯 가지 요인으로 구성되며, 이들은 ‘인지–수용–도입’의 단계적 경로를 따라 유의미한 상관관계를 형성함이 확인되었다. 반면 ‘도입 저항’은 이들과 무관하게 독립적인 인식 경로를 형성하는 별개의 요인으로 나타났다. 이러한 결과는 생성형 AI 수용이 글쓰기 전반에 대한 총체적 판단과 가치관에 기반하여 이루어짐을 보여준다. 또한 글쓰기 교육에서 생성형 AI를 기술 활용 차원에 국한하지 않고, 인지적‧정의적‧사회문화적 요인을 포괄하여 접근해야 하며, 수용 촉진과 저항 완화 전략을 함께 고려해야 함을 시사한다.
abstract_en: This study investigates university students’ perceptions of generative AI acceptance in writing and proposes a theoretical model to explain these perceptions. Based on the AIDUA (Artificial Intelligence Device Use Acceptance) framework, a three-stage process—Cognition, Acceptance, and Adoption—was constructed, with corresponding factors identified. A survey of 75 students experienced in AI-assisted writing was conducted, and exploratory factor analysis revealed five core components: Exploratory Motivation, Perceived Human-likeness, Social Influence, Expected Usefulness, and Evaluative Attitude. These factors followed a meaningful path across the three stages, while Adoption Resistance emerged as an independent factor. The results suggest that AI acceptance in writing reflects students’ holistic judgments shaped by cognitive, emotional, and sociocultural dimensions. The study underscores the need for a pedagogical approach that accounts for both the drivers and barriers to AI use in writing education.

title_ko: 중국어 수업에서 생성형 인공지능 활용에 대한 대학생의 인식과 태도 연구
title_en: A Study of University Students' Perceptions and Attitudes of Using Generative AI in Chinese Classes
kw_ko: 인공지능; 챗GPT; 설문조사; 학습자 인식; 학습자 태도
kw_en: Artificial Intelligence; ChatGPT; Questionnaire; Learner Perception; Learner Attitude
abstract_ko: 이 연구는 수도권의 한 사립대학에서 초급중국어 수업을 듣는 대학생들을 대상으로 챗GPT 등 생성형 인공지능 활용에 대한 인식과 태도를 분석하였다. 연구 결과, 학생 대부분이 챗GPT를 자주 사용하지 않았으나 사용이 어렵다고 생각하지는 않았다. 중국어 학습 도구로서 챗GPT에 대해 보통 수준의 관심을 보였고, 챗GPT가 학교 교육을 대체할 수 있는가에 대해서는 부정적이었다. 또한, 중국어 학습에 챗GPT를 사용할 때 윤리적 가이드라인 교육이 필요하며, 사용 여부를 명확히 밝혀야 한다는 의견이 많았다. ‘인공지능 + 인문 융합 교육’에 대한 관심은 보통이었지만, 이를 통해 융합형 인재가 될 수 있다고 생각하는 학생이 많았다. 챗GPT의 장점으로는 '빠름', '편리함', '다양함', '개인 맞춤형 학습', '번역 도움' 등이 있었고, 단점으로는 '부정확성', '수동적임', '실력 향상에 도움이 되지 않음', '윤리적 문제', '지나친 의존' 등이 있었다.
abstract_en: This study analyzed the perceptions and attitudes toward the use of generative AI such as ChatGPT among college students taking beginner Chinese classes at a private university in a metropolitan area. The study found that most students did not use ChatGPT frequently, but did not find it difficult to use. They were moderately interested in ChatGPT as a Chinese language learning tool, and were negative about whether ChatGPT could replace school education. They also expressed the need for education on ethical guidelines when using ChatGPT for Chinese language learning, and the need to clarify whether or not to use it. Students were moderately interested in AI + humanities convergence education, but many thought it could help them become convergent talents. title_ko: Prompt Engineering for Writing Revision: EFL Students’ Interactions with ChatGPT-3.5 for Effective Grammar and Reformulation Feedback
title_en: Prompt Engineering for Writing Revision: EFL Students’ Interactions with ChatGPT-3.5 for Effective Grammar and Reformulation Feedback
kw_en: EFL students; AI literacy; ChatGPT-3.5; prompt engineering; grammar correction; text reformulation; writing feedback
abstract_ko: This study investigates how Chinese EFL students negotiate prompts with ChatGPT-3.5 to obtain effective writing feedback on grammar correction and text reformulation. Based on qualitative case studies of four exchange students, the research highlights how students’ iterative prompt revisions shape the accuracy and usefulness of AI-generated feedback. Students with higher AI literacy demonstrated greater ability to refine prompts, resulting in feedback that better aligned with their language learning goals, while less experienced users required more attempts to achieve satisfactory results. These findings underscore the importance of explicitly integrating AI literacy instruction— especially prompt engineering—into EFL writing curricula. Educators should equip students with foundational prompting strategies to help them engage more effectively with AI tools like ChatGPT and foster greater learner autonomy in writing development.

AI 융합 중국 문화 수업은 ‘중국 문화 내용 학습, AI 학습 모델 생성, 이미지 인식 게임 만들기’라는 세 가지 단계별 학습을 통해 이루어진다. 첫 번째 단계에서 학습자는 교과서를 통해 중국 음식 문화를 학습하고 관련 이미지 데이터를 수집한다. 두 번째 단계에서 학습자는 조사한 이미지 데이터를 머신러닝 포 키즈(Machine Learning for Kids) 플랫폼을 통해 컴퓨터에 기계 학습시킨다. 세 번째 단계에서는 앞서 생성한 AI 학습 모델을 연동하여 SW 코딩 플랫폼인 스크래치(Scratch)에서 중국 음식 이미지 인식 프로젝트를 만든다. 이러한 활동을 통해 AI 융합 중국 문화교육에서 기대할 수 있는 효과는 먼저, 학습 환경의 관점에서 향후 AI 시대 중국어 교육의 상황을 예견해볼 수 있다. 다음으로 학습자의 관점에서 중국 문화에 대한 이해와 더불어 AI와 SW 융합 교육 활동을 통해 학습자의 글로벌 역량, 창의력, 사고력을 신장할 수 있다. 끝으로 교수자의 관점에서 향후 AI 기술을 활용한 교과교육이 확대되는 경우 교사가 어떤 역할을 해야 하는지 대비하고 준비할 수 있다.
abstract_en: This study proposed AI convergence Chinese cultural education through the creation of Chinese food culture and AI learning models. First of all, AI-based platforms can be used to understand the concept of machine learning and to find out the characteristics of Chinese culture. Secondly the information learned on the SW education platform is reprocessed and applied in connection with other subjects based on the later period of Chinese culture. Thirdly the educational plan can evaluate the understanding of Chinese culture. It is expected that AI convergence Chinese cultural education can be used in various fields such as Chinese language subject content development and customized curriculum development in the future.

title_ko: AI Literacy-based Storytelling Method for Fostering Primary English Language Learners' Creativity
title_en: AI Literacy-based Storytelling Method for Fostering Primary English Language Learners' Creativity
kw_ko: 디지털 스토리텔링; 인공지능 리터러시; AI 앱과 도구; 창의성; 주제범위 문헌고찰

abstract_ko: The purpose of this paper is to suggest a way of fostering primary English languagelearners(ELLs)' creativity through storytelling method based on artificial intelligence (AI)literacy. To achieve the purpose, a scoping study was conducted focused on theapplication of artificial intelligence on storytelling and to search for AI apps and toolsappropriate to improve learners' creativity through storytelling. The findings are asfollows: (1) Teachers need to help foster learners' creativity using tools such as Scratch,ACMI(Australian Centre for the Moving Image) Generator, Capzles, and SlideStory. (2) Itwas shown that big idea is important in designing lesson plans for classes based on AIliteracy. (3) Scratch, one of AI tools, enables learners to positively engage in classroomactivities and effectively foster their creativity in classes. Based on the findings, it waspresented that teachers enable learners to fill in the blank, complete the story, tell fromthe perspective of a different character, and make learner’s own story using the story of"The Roses". Also, teachers enable learners to choose parts of the elephant according totheir directions, to describe parts of the elephant according to their questions, to guessand fill in the blank, to describe what is happening in fifty words, to retell a story frommemory alone, to retell the beginning or ending of a story, to create a plot diagram, tocreate at least 2 conflicts of the story, and to evaluate a character's traits, their role inthe story, and the conflicts they experience using the story of "Six Blind Men and theElephant". It was also suggested that syllabus based on AI apps and tools should bedesigned effectively and systematically implemented for fostering ELLs’ creativity.

title_ko: 생성형 AI 기반 문학 번역의 문체 재현력 검토 -『소년이 온다』일본어 번역의 정량적(BERTScore)・정성적 분석을 중심으로-
title_en: Assessment of the Style Reproduction Capabilities of Generative AI-Based Literary Translation -Focusing on Quantitative (BERTScore) and Qualitative Analysis of the Japanese Translation of Human Acts-
kw_ko: 생성형 AI; 문학 번역; 문체 재현; 『소년이 온다』
kw_en: Generative AI; Literary Translation; BERTScore; GPT; Gemini; Style Reproduction; Human Acts
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 생성형 AI가 문학 텍스트의 감정선, 문체, 문화적 맥락을 얼마나 재현할 수 있는지를 검토하였다. 분석 대상은 한강의 『소년이 온다』로, 일본어 공식 번역본을 인간 번역의 기준(reference)으로 삼고, GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, Gemini 2.5 Flash의 번역 결과를 비교하였다. 정성적 분석에서는 인칭 호칭, 감각 표현, 문장 부호 및 단위 처리, 방언 번역, 작가 의도 훼손 여부를 중심으로 평가하였으며, 정량적 분석은 BERTScore(Precision, Recall, F1)를 활용하여 의미 유사도를 측정하였다. 분석 결과, GPT-4 계열은 감정 흐름과 시적 리듬 측면에서 비교적 안정된 번역을 보였으나, 문체 재현력과 문화 감수성에서는 인간 번역에 미치지 못하였다. Gemini 2.5 Flash는 간결한 번역이 특징이었으나, 잦은 오류와 문체 간섭 현상이 확인되었다. 본 연구는 문학 번역에 있어 생성형 AI의 한계와 가능성을 함께 조망하며, 향후 정서 기반 튜닝 및 인간-기계 협업 모델의 필요성을 시사한다.
abstract_en: With the growing adoption of generative AI in translation, this study examines its ability to reproduce literary style and emotional depth through a comparative analysis of Human Acts by Han Kang. Using the official Japanese translation as a human reference and outputs from GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, and Gemini 2.5 Flash, the research assesses both qualitative and quantitative aspects of translation quality. Qualitative analysis focuses on errors in pronoun usage, hallucination, tone disruption, dialect handling, and stylistic fidelity. Quantitative analysis uses BERTScore (Precision, Recall, F1) to evaluate semantic similarity. Results show that while GPT-4o demonstrates relatively stable performance in emotional and poetic passages, it still falls short of human translation in cultural sensitivity and rhythm reproduction. Gemini 2.5 Flash shows compact outputs but frequent hallucinations and stylistic mismatches. These findings suggest that despite high BERTScore values, generative AI translations still require human post-editing to achieve literary completeness.

title_ko: 生成式AI与人工教师在韩国学习者 动态助词“了ㆍ着ㆍ过”偏误修正中的比较研究 章
title_en: A Comparative Study of Generative AI and Human Teachers in Correcting Korean Learners’ Errors with the Chinese Aspectual Particles ‘了’, ‘着’, and ‘过’
kw_ko: 동태조사; 생성형 인공지능; 문법 오류 수정; 인간-AI 비교; HSK 동적 작문 말뭉치
kw_en: 动态助词；生成式人工智能；偏误修正；人机比较；HSK动态作文语料库; Dynamic aspect markers; Generative artificial intelligence; Grammatical error correction; Human-AI comparison; HSK dynamic composition corpus
abstract_ko: 本研究以韩国汉语学习者的中介语语料为基础，考察动态助词“了、着、过”的偏误 类型，并比较人工教师与以ChatGPT-5、DeepSeek 为代表的人工智能系统在语法纠错中的 修正策略与效果。研究发现，人工智能在高频、规则性强的显性偏误修正方面具有较高效 率，其修改结果在形式正确性上与教师较为接近；但在涉及语义辨析、体貌功能区分及篇 章连贯性的问题上，AI 的修正多停留于形式层面，缺乏系统解释与教学指向。相较之 下，人工教师能够结合语境与体貌语义，对偏误进行有针对性的分析与反馈，更有助于学 习者建构体貌理解。基于研究结果，本文认为当前AI 更适宜作为语法纠错的辅助工具， 并提出推动纠错系统向可解释化、教学化方向发展的应用建议，以实现人机协同的汉语教 学模式。
abstract_en: This study examines error patterns in the use of the dynamic aspect markers le, zhe, and guo in the interlanguage of Korean learners of Chinese, and compares the corrective strategies and effects of human teachers with those of artificial intelligence systems represented by ChatGPT-5 and DeepSeek in grammatical error correction. The findings indicate that AI demonstrates high efficiency in correcting frequent and rule-based overt errors, producing revisions that are largely comparable to those of teachers in terms of formal grammatical accuracy. However, when errors involve semantic distinctions, aspectual function differentiation, or discourse-level coherence, AI corrections tend to remain at a surface level, lacking systematic explanation and pedagogical orientation. In contrast, human teachers integrate contextual information and aspectual semantics to provide targeted analysis and feedback, which better supports learners’ construction of aspectual understanding. Based on these findings, this study argues that AI is currently more suitable as a supplementary tool for grammatical error correction, and proposes promoting the development of AI correction systems toward greater interpretability and pedagogical integration in order to achieve a human-AI collaborative model of Chinese language teaching.

title_ko: 학부생 번역자의 중한 기계번역 포스트에디팅 사례연구
title_en: A Study on Undergraduates Trainee Translators’ Chinese-Korean Machine Translation Post-editing
kw_ko: 기계번역; 포스트에디팅; 번역 교육; 중한번역; 네이버 파파고
kw_en: machine translation; post-editing; translation education; Korean-Chinese translation; Naver Papago
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 학부 번역수업에 텍스트 유형 별(정보적, 설득적) 중국어→한국어(B언어 →A언어) 기계번역 포스트에디팅 연습을 진행하고, 포스트에디팅 결과물을 분석하여 학부생들이 가장 많이 문제를 보인 사항 및 구체적인 양상을 살펴보았다. 분석 결과, 중국어-한국어 기계번역 포스트에디팅에서 학부생들이 가장 많이 문제를 보인 부분은 의미 항목의 정확성, 어휘와 문법 항목의 어휘인 것을 확인할 수 있었다. 또한, 학부생들은 맥락을 고려하지 않은 단어나 구 차원의 수정, 메시지 전달에만 집중하며 문체 특징 및 번역의 기능 등에 소홀한 문제가 두드러졌다. 포스트에디팅 문제 양상은 텍스트 유형에 따라 차이를 보였다. 의미 항목의 정확성 경우, 정보적 텍스트는 주로 단어 문제가 관찰되었으나, 설득적 텍스트에서는 연결 절의 논리관계, 강조어 등 화자 태도표현 문제가 주로 나타났다. 언어와 문법 항목의 어휘 경우, 정보적 텍스트는 대상독자의 상황과 배경지식을 고려하지 않은 문제가 나타난 반면, 설득적 텍스트는 청자 설득을 위한 수사적 효과를 고려하지 못한 문제가 관찰되었다. 이 밖에 정보적 텍스트와 설득적 텍스트 기계번역 포스트에디팅에서 모두 복잡한 중국어 복문, 중국어 문장부호를 정확하게 수정하지 못한 문제가 관찰되었다. 본 연구는 중국어-한국어 기계번역의 포스트에디팅 교육사례를 수집․분석한 첫 연구로서, 향후 관련 교육 및 연구에 기초자료로 활용될 수 있을 것으로 기대된다.
abstract_en: This paper aims to show which problems are frequently observed in Naver Papago machine translation post-editing performed by undergraduate students majoring in Chinese-Korean translation and the differences in post-editing by text type(informative and expressive).The post-editing output is evaluated, using Yoon’s (2018) post-editing guidelines: accuracy, completeness, consistency, lexis, syntax, spelling, punctuation, style, and format.Analysis shows that the most common problems were accuracy and lexis. The problems of trying to resolve word-level issues without considering co-text, and paying scant attention to unnatural or ungrammatical language forms were outstanding.The post-editing problems differed according to the text type. In the case of accuracy, word-level problem was mainly observed in informative text, but in expressive text, expressing the speaker's attitude problem, such as the logical relations and emphasis, was mainly observed. In the case of lexis, students did not take into account the situation and background knowledge of target reader in informative text, whereas in persuasive text they did not consider the rhetorical effect. In addition, in both informative and persuasive text machine translation post-editings, the Chinese complex sentences and Chinese punctuation errors were not corrected accurately.This is the first study to collect and analyze machine translation post-editing education in Chinese-Korean translation, such applications and examples can serve as a foundation for following researches to go deeper in this field.

title_ko: 중국어 교육의 생성형 AI 활용 효과와 방안 연구
title_en: Effects and Proposals of Using Generative AI in Chinese Education
kw_en: Generative AI; Language Education; Chinese Dialog
abstract_ko: In education, Generative AI is being used as a way to increase competencies along with subject matter knowledge. As AI is being used in education, the potential for personalization and active education is being studied, and it is necessary to study the application and effectiveness of Generative AI in education as it develops in the fields of assisting, collaborating, and coaching. It is expected that Generative AI will be used in education not only as an educational content creation tool, but also as a tutor and assistant in a role-split interaction. Therefore, in the Chinese language class, we will look at the steps to utilize Generative AI after basic Chinese language acquisition as creating 'conversation scenarios' and creating interactive video content. A survey was conducted before the use of Generative AI, after the role-divided interaction, and after the educational content creation tool, and the results showed significant positive effects on class participation, interest, satisfaction, and motivation. Of these, interest and satisfaction had the highest effects. “Role-splitting interaction” had a higher effect on engagement and satisfaction, and ‘educational content creation tools’ had a higher effect on interest. The overall competency effect of using Generative AI was on communication and critical thinking, and the effect of role-splitting interaction was on content, critical thinking, creative innovation, and self-confidence compared to educational content creation tools, which showed an overall increase in self-confidence. Training should extend experience from knowledge transfer to validate knowledge and increase flexibility and the ability to utilize vast amounts of knowledge under different conditions.

abstract_ko: Đây là một nghiên cứu điển hình về việc học tập Tandem sử dụng nền tảng vũ trụ ảo trong lớp học tiếng Việt-tiếng Hàn. Mục tiêu của nghiên cứu là khám phá khả năng của việc học tập Tandem tiếng Việt–tiếng Hàn sử dụng nền tảng vũ trụ ảo và tìm kiếm phương pháp dạy ngoại ngữ hiệu quả hơn so với các phương pháp truyền thống. Để đạt được điều này, nghiên cứu đã cung cấp cái nhìn sâu sắc về cấu trúc khóa học đã tích hợp phương pháp học tập Tandem, các tương tác giữa người học trên nền tảng vũ trụ ảo, và kết quả khảo sát phản ánh kinh nghiệm học tập và nhận thức của họ về phương pháp tiếp cận này. Nghiên cứu này có ý nghĩa quan trọng khi nó đã cung cấp một môi trường học tập mới sử dụng vũ trụ ảo, cho phép người học tham gia tích cực hơn. abstract_en: This is a case study of tandem learning using a metaverse platform in a Vietnamese-Korean language course. It aimed to explore more efficient foreign language teaching methods beyond traditional approaches. To achieve this, the study provides an in-depth look at the course structure that incorporated tandem learning, the interactions between learners on the metaverse platform, and survey results reflecting their learning experiences and perceptions of this particular approach. This study is significant in that it provided a new learning environment using the metaverse, enabling more active participation from learners. It also integrated the tandem learning method, which allows learners to actively participate in the mutual language acquisition process as both target language learners and as instructors or experts of the partner’s target language. Furthermore, the study is meaningful for its specific attempt to design tandem learning classes using the metaverse, particularly for Vietnamese-Korean classes.

title_ko: Personalized Korean Language Learning Using AI-Driven Pronunciation Diagnosis and Visual Feedback
title_en: Personalized Korean Language Learning Using AI-Driven Pronunciation Diagnosis and Visual Feedback
kw_en: Korean language learning; pronunciation assessment; L1 transfer; multimodal AI system; self-correction feedback
abstract_ko: Learning Korean as a second language is difficult because of its unique phonological features, including three-way consonant contrasts, syllable-final consonant restrictions, and context-dependent sound changes. A key challenge is that learner errors are not random—they follow predictable patterns shaped by the learner's native language (L1). Existing language learning systems based on automatic speech recognition (ASR) typically provide only pass/fail feedback at the word level, which is insufficient for helping learners understand and correct their pronunciation. To address these limitations, this paper proposes an AI-driven Korean language learning system that models L1-dependent pronunciation and grammar error patterns and delivers personalized, actionable feedback. The system processes both speech and text inputs to detect errors at the phoneme and sentence levels. Since large labeled datasets of Korean learner speech are difficult to obtain, the system adopts a self-correction approach: instead of explicitly labeling errors, it compares learner speech with native speaker speech and visualizes the differences using simple geometric representations derived from waveform and spectral features. This allows learners to intuitively recognize where their pronunciation differs and to improve gradually through an imitation–feedback loop. The proposed framework is evaluated in a realworld mobile learning environment, demonstrating its practicality for everyday use. Experimental results show that the system effectively identifies L1-specific error tendencies and provides feedback that supports iterative pronunciation improvement. This work contributes a quantitative error modeling framework, a multimodal AI diagnosis system, and a visualization-based self-correction paradigm that together advance the development of scalable and personalized Korean language learning technology.

title_ko: 인공지능(ChatGPT)을 활용한 중학생 시 쓰기 교육 실제
title_en: Middle school students using artificial intelligence (ChatGPT) the actual writing education
kw_ko: 중학생 글쓰기; 시 창작 교육; 인공지능 시대 글쓰기; 중학생 작문; 챗지피티 작문

abstract_ko: 목적 본 연구에서는 중학생들을 대상으로 인공지능(ChatGPT)을 활용한 시 쓰기를 시도하고, 글쓰기 도구로써 인공지능의 가능성을 탐구한다. 인공지능은 인간 고유의 영역이라 여기는 창의적 글쓰기까지 가능하다는 관점에서 창의성의 개념 문제, 표절, 윤리적인문제, 인간 고유의 사고 문제 등 비판적인 문제가 논의되고 있다. 글쓰기의 개념이 변화하고 있는 시대에 교육 역시 새로운 접근과방법이 필요하다. 따라서 인공지능 시대에 적극적으로 대응하여 시 쓰기 교육의 새로운 방향성을 제시하고자 한다. 방법 경기도 소재 중학생 148명(여학생 67명, 남학생 81명)을 대상으로 인공지능(ChatGPT)을 활용한 시 쓰기를 실시하였다. 먼저 자신을 소개한 글을 프롬프트에 입력하여 인공지능에게 ‘나는~이다’라는 방식으로 정의를 내려달라고 요청한다. 이후 산출된 정의를 활용하여 시를 쓰고, 이를 다시 인공지능을 활용하여 ‘고쳐쓰기’ 한 뒤 최종 결과물을 제출하였다. 설문을 통해 인공지능이 어떤단계에서 유용했는지 결과를 분석해 보았다. 결과 학생들은 인공지능(ChatGPT)을 활용하여 시를 쓴다는 것에 대해 흥미를 보였고, 계속되는 질문 끝에 ‘나는~이다’라는 비유를도출해냈다. 하지만 어떻게 입력해야 원하는 결과물이 나오는지 질문 생성에 많은 어려움을 겪었다. 이후 설문에서 글쓰기에 자신감을 가진 학생일수록 향후 인공지능 사용에 대한 긍정적인 반응을 보였다. 인공지능을 활용한 시 쓰기 후, 인공지능이 유용한 도구라생각할수록 향후 사용 계획이 높게 나타났다. 또한 인공지능은 글쓰기의 ‘표현하기, 고쳐쓰기’ 단계에서 시 쓰기에 도움이 된다는의견을 보였다. 결론 인공지능(ChatGPT)은 글쓰기에 도움을 줄 수 있는 하나의 도구로써 활용 가능하나, 시에 대한 이해가 선행되지 않으면 활용하기 어려웠다. 질문 생성 능력은 곧 글쓰는 주제와 목적, 장르의 이해가 선행되어야 키울 수 있다. 질문하는 능력은 곧 문제 해결 능력과연결된다. 또한 자신의 글과 인공지능이 도출하는 문장의 적절성을 판단하여 위해서는 언어적 능력과 예술적 심미안을 키우는 교육이 이루어져야 한다.
abstract_en: Objectives In this study, middle school students try to write poetry using artificial intelligence (ChatGPT) and explore the possibility of artificial intelligence as a writing tool. Critical issues such as conceptual problems of creativity, plagiarism, ethical problems, and human-specific thinking problems are being discussed from the perspective that artificial intelligence is capable of creative writing, which is considered a unique area of humans. In an era when the concept of writing is changing, education also needs a new approach and method. Therefore, we would like to actively respond to the era of artificial intelligence and present a new direction for poetry writing education. Methods 148 middle school students (67 female students and 81 male students) in Gyeonggi-do were subjected to poetry writing using artificial intelligence (ChatGPT). First, enter the text introducing yourself at the prompt and ask artificial intelligence to define it in a way that says, “I am~.” After that, a poem was written using the calculated definition, and the final result was submitted after ‘correcting’ it using artificial intelligence again. The results of the survey were analyzed at what stage artificial intelligence was helpful. title_ko: 인공지능 기반 자동번역기 파파고를 활용한 초등영어 학습의 효과
title_en: Effectiveness of Elementary English Learning Using Artificial Intelligence-based Automatic Translator
kw_ko: 인공지능; 자동번역기; 파파고; 초등영어; 인식도
kw_en: Artificial Intelligence; Automatic Translator; Papago; Primary English; Perception
abstract_ko: 연구 목적: 본 연구는 인공지능 기반의 자동번역기인 파파고를 활용한 영어 학습에 대한 초등영어학습자들의 인식 정도를 살펴보는데 그 목적이 있다. 연구 방법: 6학년 초등영어학습자 2명을 대상으로 약 두 달간 질적 연구 방법인 문화기술 조사를 실시하였다. 자료 수집을 위하여 참여관찰과 심층면담을 진행하였으며 이후 현장관찰 노트와 메모, 면담 내용은 전사하여 내용분석 기법을 통해 분석하였다. 연구 내용: 수집된 데이터를 질적으로 분석하여 결과, 파파고 기반 영어 학습을 통해 문법, 어휘, 발음 면에서 영어 능력이 향상되었음을 확인할 수 있었다. 결론 및 제언: 인공지능 기반의 자동번역기의 적절한 활용은 영어 능숙도(어휘, 발음, 문법) 향상에 있어 유의미한 영향을 끼치는 것으로 판단할 수 있었으며 영어 수업 시간을 제외하고 영어에 대한 노출이 전무한 환경을 고려했을 때 이러한 도구의 활용은 자기 주도적 학습이나 능력 계발에 있어서도 중요한 영향을 미친다고 볼 수 있었다.
abstract_en: This study is to examine the extent to which elementary English learners perceive English learning through an artificial intelligence-based automatic translator, Papago. To this end, an ethnographic case study was conducted for about two months on two 6th-grade elementary English learners. Participatory observation and in-depth interviews were conducted for data collection, and after that, field observation notes, memos, and interview contents were transcribed and analyzed through content analysis techniques. Based on the findings and increasing the possibility of generalization through the triangulation, it was confirmed that English skills in terms of grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation were improved through Papago-based English learning. The results showed that the proper use of an artificial intelligence-based automatic translator had a significant effect on improving English proficiency (vocabulary, pronunciation, grammar), and that the use of these tools had an important effect on self-directed learning and ability development, considering EFL environment.
